title: Time to become indestructible (Self-Improvement Q&A)
summary: Three-hour Saturday self-improvement Q&A stream covering socializing, neurodiversity, discipline, masks and morality, dating, careers and a handful of training topics. He argues strength and physical culture let you stay sensitive without being disrespected, and scatters training opinions (intensity over volume, no deloads, short workouts for busy people, cardio placement on a cut).
claims: Manual labour like chopping up a fallen tree with a machete feels good for body and soul and is more satisfying than desk work
During a breakup training and lifts suffer; you just have to keep pushing forward and get used to that feeling because it will recur in life
He would not become a cyborg for better gains because it would cost him his humanity
You should build your morality through experience, deciding what you like and dislike, instead of letting society dictate it
He refuses ads on his videos partly because ads blast loudly and could wake viewers who fall asleep to his videos
2024 is the best time in history to be jacked because almost nobody is
To stay sensitive and soft without being disrespected you need strength built through physical culture; a big man can love kittens and nobody mocks him
In his first year of college the courses were so easy he lost all drive, fell into League of Legends (reached Diamond 1), and escaped by doubling down on walking, training and reading
On rest days stay lightly active (push-mowing, walking, hiking) but passive recovery on the couch reading or watching TV is also important for bodybuilding
If the chest will not grow no matter the volume, find a chest exercise you actually connect with; volume that does not reach the chest is useless
He cooks mostly with olive oil and sometimes butter
Bodybuilding is functional: heavy rows and a strong grip let him rip whole tangled branches and trees down by pulling
He has a moral problem with charging money for helping people and would live on the bare minimum if he were not married
If you struggle to make friends in college, force yourself to socialize; the longer you stay isolated the harder it becomes
Outsiders should not take pride in not being normies; to get a job or social life, observe normies, learn what makes them tick and mask
He does not drink alcohol; in public people stare, ignore him or compliment him, and nobody has ever tried to fight him
Stoicism's rejection of anger suited aggressive ancient men; domesticated modern men should embrace anger if it fuels their will, without letting it consume them
At about 19 and 170-180 lb, at a party every arriving man greeted him and ignored the beautiful woman he was talking to, assuming she was his: size changes how men treat you
Confidence to talk to women without alcohol can be learned; relying on alcohol to disinhibit can become a crutch and an addiction
If you take up BJJ you cannot keep growing muscle unless you are a novice; BJJ is extremely time-consuming and you will have to choose
All men should learn to defend themselves physically; martial arts classes can be a door into physical culture
A friend who starts using steroids is probably lost, since he will end up only hanging out with other juicers
People pleasers must please themselves first; do not set yourself on fire to keep others warm or you become a target for abusers
He disagrees with masculinity gurus that hookups are good for men: they gave him nothing and hookup culture hurts young women
As a kid he took piano lessons for three years by memorizing pieces by ear without knowing how to read music, then quit when found out
At 5'7 a man is about average; avoid resentment and develop charisma, humour and social skills, which matter more than height
He acknowledges he should make a twice-a-week program for casual lifters
Self-sacrifice is noble, but helping others only works if you stay self-sustainable; constantly spreading yourself thin turns kind people bitter
He is very likely autistic but was never diagnosed because of France's attitude to autism; struggling socially forced him to learn skills that now let him integrate
Neurodivergent people need to be taught skills to function in a neurotypical society, not shielded; masking is sometimes what it takes
In college or university friend groups form in the first few months; waiting until November or December is too late
When you meet people from your past after transforming, they see the new you; ride the confidence you earned rather than shrinking
He still feels like the small effeminate kid around his family despite his size
America admires big guys as aspirational while France resents them, which he attributes to Protestant versus Catholic ethics
He keeps no rigid time schedule; he lists what must be done and tackles tasks in order of excitement to build momentum toward harder ones
He started bodybuilding partly to be left alone after bullies kept slapping books out of his hands in middle school
Bodybuilding works like a martial art: looking powerful means people do not mess with you whether or not you can fight
Dips are hugely underrated for bodybuilding; he does them with three plates plus two 10s for sets of five
If your face gets chubby on a bulk you are bulking too hard; cut inflammatory and water-retaining foods, or hide it with a beard
He does not fast because it gives him dark thoughts, and he sees no reason to spend time with depleted glycogen when eating well builds his physique
Working a trade for 20 years then starting university at 40 is a bad plan; take night classes while working instead
He is a mid-head, not a biomechanics nerd; dissecting which exercise hits which biceps head leads to bad programs with five curls; pick two or three and train hard
Between volume and intensity he would choose both, but these days intensity
Fitness Instagram is oversaturated so nobody will care about your posts; just have fun with it
25 is not old for a man; do not enter a relationship out of parental pressure or you will end up in a bad one
His number one self-improvement tip is to schedule dedicated time each day for improvement
For worries you cannot control, stoicism helps: recognize you have no control and let it go to focus on what you can change
He will never get LASIK: he likes glasses and thinks the risks are understated and side effects permanent
Following Nietzsche, everyone wears masks; in corporate and academic settings never drop your professional mask, as he was backstabbed in academia
With a full-time job, Muay Thai 3x/week and family duties, keep workouts short (under 30 min), not too taxing, and done first thing on waking
Neglecting a passion does not mean you do not love it; it is a discipline problem: make the choice, make a plan, then results follow
Talent only goes so far; even Hendrix practiced around five hours a day
He can talk bodybuilding endlessly but cannot teach you the drive to actually go do it
Study for something you are passionate about, since you will compete against people who are
To study: put the phone away, use about one hour of study per five-minute break, and start now rather than waiting for the next round hour
A quick high-calorie snack is oats loaded with bananas and honey
Sandbag training is not practical for hypertrophy
You need to be both fox and lion; being a weasel gives plausible deniability in a litigious society
Doing six reps to failure will build muscle
If you feel lazy after college and gym, you are not managing your energy well
To test a business partner, give them a small amount of access or money and see how they handle it
He despises merch: drop-shipped junk that feeds parasocial attachment
On YouTube you must choose between playing the algorithm (clickbait, trends) and making what you want; he chose the latter and remains small
Many young men think the gym will fix their life; it will not by itself; it should build confidence you then apply socially
Always accept compliments graciously; dismissing them looks weak, but spiritually try to keep the emotional high in check, as Musashi's unchanged spirit teaches
Relying on blaring music to hit PRs burns you out; do about 90% of the workout in silence or with classical music or a podcast and save loud music for top sets
A top set is simply the set of the day done with the most weight for an exercise
Some people are more injury- or sickness-prone; if hard training makes you sick or hurt, train less hard and adapt the stimulus rather than hoping your body changes
Remove temptation from your environment, such as not keeping treats at home, rather than proving virtue by resisting it
He organizes his thoughts by writing them down on scraps of paper just to get them out of his head
If you suspect ADHD, get diagnosed; a proper routine lets you work with your brain instead of against it
Reading endlessly without applying ideas is like collecting gym equipment and never training
On a cut do cardio separately, e.g. in the morning, because energy is too low to do it right before or after lifting; on a bulk before or after lifting is fine
Natural men peak in size and strength in their 40s; steroid culture created the idea that you peak in your 20s
Most men look their worst in their 20s and 30s physical prime because they let themselves go
He would only cut or compete during a period when he had little time for the gym
He will not learn Olympic weightlifting: too technical and time-consuming, hypertrophy takes all his time
Deloads after periods of high volume and intensity are idiotic; do slightly less and never need a week off, getting about 25% more work across two weeks
Avoid burnout the same way: do slightly less and let consistency make up for it
If it is between sleep and watching the stream, always choose sleep
For gloomy weather get a sun lamp and go bask in the sun whenever it shows, whatever the temperature
He is not a fan of Tom Platz's mindset, which overemphasizes insanity
Self-esteem is action-based: it comes from building a character and life you see as worthy
He is an active pessimist like Guts: less cheerful daily but prepared when things go wrong, whereas active optimists like Griffith collapse on failure
Taking PEDs is a form of dangerous delusion
With no real role models he took them from anime and manga; fictional role models are valid
Introverts need less social contact; after a stream he rests about an hour before he can work out
Getting cold out is no excuse to skip training
exercises: hugely underrated for chest and bodybuilding
build grip and pulling strength that carries over to real tasks
no need for one exercise per biceps head
too technical and time-consuming for a hypertrophy focus
